objective: Decide whether to advance a valuation review for fictional Fern Ledger Ltd as of 2026-11-27.

sources.title: Management memo
sources.extract: Fern Ledger Ltd says monthly recurring revenue was USD 123,000 and claims ARR of USD 1,476,000. No peer evidence accompanied the asking valuation.

sources.title: Subscription ledger
sources.extract: Opening cohort recurring revenue USD 100,000. Expansion USD 20,000, contraction USD 5,000, churn USD 10,000. New cohort recurring revenue USD 10,000. The USD 123,000 billed total includes USD 8,000 one-time implementation fees.

sources.title: Packet inventory
sources.extract: No dated bank statement or comparable transaction data were supplied. Accounting and management use the same legal entity.

questions.question: Give existing-cohort gross recurring revenue retention as a percentage number.
Give existing-cohort net recurring revenue retention as a percentage number.
Give run-rate ARR in whole USD using closing recurring revenue including the new cohort.
Classify the USD 1,476,000 ARR claim as supported, contradicted, different_basis, or unknown.
Give a defensible enterprise value in USD from this packet or null.

priority_options.CASH: Current unrestricted cash and reconciled balances.
priority_options.COMPS: Dated comparable terms and matched revenue basis.
